constraints: Preserve the routes, rendering modes, data fetching, and public behavior of the application; change only what each official upgrade guide requires.
Upgrade one major at a time (13, 14, 15, then 16) and verify each step before the next.

steps.instructions: Set the next dependency to the Active LTS release (16.x) in the package.json that declares it, then align react and react-dom with the versions the guides require. The 15 guide requires React 19.
steps.title: Move next to a supported major

steps.instructions: Work through the official upgrade guides for 13, 14, 15 and 16, one major at a time, and resolve each breaking change they list before starting the next. Check the Node.js minimum each guide states.
steps.title: Apply the upgrade guides in order

steps.instructions: Run the codemods the guides name (for example the upgrade codemod from @next/codemod) or make the same changes by hand, and review every change before committing.
steps.title: Run the official codemods

steps.instructions: Replace the imports, components, and configuration options that the guides rename or remove, such as the target option removed in Next.js 13 and next lint removed in Next.js 16.
steps.title: Replace renamed or removed APIs

verification.purpose: Build the application with the upgraded Next.js.
Run the repository tests when defined.
Lint with the ESLint CLI; the next lint command is removed in Next.js 16.
